lines.text: Two chips. One frozen safety core.
DG32-LITE runs two cores in lockstep, checked against each other, continuously.
When they disagree, hardware shuts the motor bridge in thirty-nine cycles. No firmware in the path.
The placed-and-routed core closes at fifty-five to sixty-two megahertz, so it runs at a safe fifty.
One motor-control loop costs about three hundred cycles of hardware. At ten kilohertz, eighty-two percent is left for diagnostics.
DG32-2DOM adds an attention engine on its own one-hundred-fourteen megahertz clock, behind bridges.
Two chips. One frozen safety core.
